name: deep-research
description: Multi-step, cited research: search, screen, verify and write a structured report with a validated reference list.

interface.shortDescription: Cited multi-step research with literature search and verification
interface.longDescription: Plans a research question, searches literature (Europe PMC / PubMed) and the web, screens and verifies sources, and writes a structured report with validated [n] citations and a reference list saved to Documents/DeepResearch.
defaultPrompt: Use deep-research to review the literature on a clinical topic and give an evidence table.
Use deep-research to compare options for a technical or market decision with cited sources.
Use deep-research to prepare a cited briefing for a 25-minute talk, including figures worth showing.
